questions.question: Which of the following best describes the function of the cell membrane?
options: It provides structural rigidity to the plant cell
It controls the movement of substances in and out of the cell
It is the site of protein synthesis
It stores the genetic information of the cell
questions.model_answer: The cell membrane controls the movement of substances in and out of the cell. It is selectively permeable, allowing certain molecules to pass while restricting others.
questions.verification_note: Model answer is directly supported by the source chunk's description of selective permeability and boundary function of the cell membrane.
questions.explanation_en: The cell membrane is the outer living boundary of all cells. It physically separates the intracellular space from the extracellular environment, protecting the cytoplasm and regulating what enters and exits the cell.
questions.explanation_ur: خلوی جھلی تمام خلیوں کی بیرونی زندہ حد ہے۔ یہ اندرونی حصے کو بیرونی ماحول سے الگ کرتی ہے، سائٹوپلازم کی حفاظت کرتی ہے اور خلیے کے اندر اور باہر مادوں کی نقل و حرکت کو کنٹرول کرتی ہے۔
questions.explanation_ur_roman: Cell membrane tamam khaliyon ki beruni zinda had hai jo intracellular space ko extracellular mahol se alag karti hai aur madon ki aamad o raft ko control karti hai.

questions.question: Differentiate between a cell wall and a cell membrane. Give two points of difference.
questions.model_answer: Cell wall: (1) Present only in plant cells, fungi, and bacteria. (2) Made of cellulose in plants; it is rigid and provides structural support. Cell membrane: (1) Present in all living cells (plant and animal). (2) Made of a phospholipid bilayer; it is flexible and selectively permeable.
questions.verification_note: Both points of difference are explicitly stated in the source chunk, which contrasts cell wall composition and distribution with those of the cell membrane.
questions.explanation_en: The cell wall is a tough, rigid non-living layer found outside the cell membrane in plants and bacteria, composed primarily of cellulose. The cell membrane is present in all living cells as a flexible boundary.
questions.explanation_ur: خلوی دیوار ایک سخت، غیر جاندار حفاظتی تہہ ہے جو پودوں کے خلیوں میں سیلولوز سے بنتی ہے۔ خلوی جھلی تمام جاندار خلیوں میں لچکدار حد کے طور پر موجود ہوتی ہے۔
questions.explanation_ur_roman: Cell wall ek sakht, ghair jandar teh hai jo poudon mein cellulose se banti hai. Cell membrane tamam zinda khaliyon mein flexible boundary ke tor par mojood hoti hai.

questions.question: Which organelle is responsible for producing energy (ATP) in the cell through cellular respiration?
questions.model_answer: Mitochondria are responsible for producing ATP through the process of cellular respiration. They are known as the powerhouse of the cell.
questions.verification_note: Model answer is directly supported by the source chunk (Mitochondria section, p. 77), which states that during aerobic respiration energy is produced in the form of ATP, making mitochondria the 'Power house' of the cell.
questions.explanation_en: Mitochondria carry out cellular respiration, converting nutrients into ATP energy. Because of this energy production, mitochondria are known as the 'powerhouse of the cell'.
questions.explanation_ur: مائٹوکانڈریا خلوی تنفس کا مرکز ہے جہاں توانائی ATP کی شکل میں پیدا ہوتی ہے۔ اسی لیے مائٹوکانڈریا کو خلیے کا 'پاور ہاؤس' کہا جاتا ہے۔
questions.explanation_ur_roman: Mitochondria cellular respiration ka markaz hai jahan tawanai ATP ki shakal mein banti hai. Isi liye mitochondria ko cell ka 'Powerhouse' kaha jata hai.
